text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager -> high: Boreal Systems (private VPC) - auth failures to tenant-dedicated pool (mTLS handshake errors). Please acknowledge.
Oncall Pager: ack. I'm oncall. Initial triage: are we seeing 5xx from the bridge or 401/403 from the auth service?
Samir (SRE): we're getting a mix. Customer traffic hitting the VPC bridge shows TLS alert handshake_failure and downstream edge returns 502. Auth-proxy logs show 'client certificate verify failed: certificate has expired'.
Priya (Platform Eng): confirmed in metrics: spike in TLS errors at 12:01 UTC with sustained failures to Boreal's dedicated pool. Their tenant_id=tenant-boreal. Can Lindsey pull the customer-side timeline?
Lindsey (Support): Boreal reports first errors at ~11:58 UTC. They attempted a restart of their sidecar and saw no improvement. They uploaded a new cert to their vault at 12:05 but didn't activate it (per their ops notes). Evan from Boreal on thread.
Evan (Customer IAM): Hi, yeah we rotated certs this morning but the keystore alias on our side was wrong so the old cert expired at 12:00 and we didn't bind the new one. We're ready to provide the new chain if you need it.
Samir (SRE): thanks. Quick mitigation options: 1) reload redwood auth-proxy keystore to pick up new client cert if customer uploads it to our accepted bucket, 2) temporarily open a bypass route to our hosted auth (we'd need customer approval), 3) route Boreal traffic to a fallback dedicated pool that accepts legacy token introspection.
Priya (Platform Eng): we can do a rolling restart of the vpc-auth proxy in the tenant bridge to force reload of truststore. Command: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/vpc-auth-proxy -n tenant-boreal-bridge``` but only after cert is in place. We also have a built-in 'keystore-reload' endpoint on the bridge: ```POST /admin/keystore/reload``` (restricted).
Evan (Customer IAM): we can push the cert to the shared s3 bucket now. It's the full chain + intermediate. Please confirm exact filename/location and we'll push.
Samir (SRE): Send to s3://redwood-ingest/tenant-boreal/certs/client_chain.pem. I'll validate with openssl after you upload.
Evan (Customer IAM): uploaded at s3://redwood-ingest/tenant-boreal/certs/client_chain_2026-03-15.pem
Samir (SRE): pulling it now... ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ingest/tenant-boreal/certs/client_chain_2026-03-15.pem - | openssl x509 -noout -text | grep -E "Not After|Subject"``` output: "Not After : Mar 20 12:00:00 2028 GMT" -> chain looks valid.
Priya (Platform Eng): OK. I'll trigger keystore update on bridge. Steps: 1) patch secret, 2) POST reload endpoint, 3) watch auth-proxy logs for handshake success. Command we run: ```kubectl create secret generic tenant-boreal-client --from-file=client_chain.pem=client_chain_2026-03-15.pem -n tenant-boreal-bridge && curl -s -X POST https://bridge.tenant-boreal.internal/admin/keystore/reload -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"```
DeployBot: deploy started by Priya at 12:14:32 UTC. Rolling update -> 3 pods.
Samir (SRE): logs tail: ```vpc-auth-proxy[1]: [12:15:01] keystore reload success; loaded 1 client certs
vpc-auth-proxy[1]: [12:15:12] TLS handshake succeeded for CN=client-boreal
edge-proxy[2]: [12:15:13] proxied request tenant-boreal status=200 latency=45ms``` Good sign.
Lindsey (Support): Boreal confirms successful request at 12:15:20 UTC. They're still seeing a few stragglers but overall traffic is flowing.
Oncall Pager: temporary mitigation in place. Do we need to open a scheduled change to rotate keys end-to-end with Boreal? Also confirm post-incident follow-up items.
Evan (Customer IAM): we'd like a 1-hr maintenance window to rotate our aliases and update keystore binding. Also can you add an alert to catch client cert expiry <72h? We missed expiry notification.
Samir (SRE): action items: - Create alert rule for tenant client cert expiry (<72h) - Add automated freshness check for certs in s3 vs vault - Improve our on-call runbook to include the /admin/keystore/reload step and the fallback routing option. I'll open the tickets.
Priya (Platform Eng): Postmortem note: cause = customer keystore alias mis-bind after cert rotation led to expired cert presented to bridge. Contributing: no alert for cert expiry and no automated keystore activation verification. Resolution: keystore updated + bridge reload -> service restored at 12:15:20 UTC. Impact: ~17 minutes service degradation for Boreal, partial 5xx and 401s. No data loss reported.
Lindsey (Support): communicated restoration to Boreal, they are OK with a 1-hour maintenance to finalize. Will schedule.
Incident Bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 12:30 UTC. All clear? :white_check_mark:
Oncall Pager: closing pager. Leaving follow-ups assigned to Samir and Priya. Thanks everyone.
Samir (SRE): I'll file the follow-up tickets and link to this thread.
Evan (Customer IAM): thanks to the team for quick turnaround. We'll coordinate the scheduled maintenance.
DeployBot: done. rolling update completed at 12:15:45 UTC.
